integrity: The result has a self-contained abstract proof and deterministic finite cross-checks. The finite checks are not a proof of its universal quantifier. Mathematical originality is provisional subject to independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers finite connected simple graphs whose simple four-cycles are pairwise edge-disjoint and includes at least one four-cycle. It does not classify overlapping squares, assert a direct collapse of the neighborhood complex itself, or establish a functorial equivariant homotopy equivalence.
title: Graph-like neighborhood complexes with edge-disjoint four-cycles
